data.body:
[P1] Track invoke payload serialization before shortening the cooldown

`createInvokeHandler` awaits `safeSerialize` before registering the operation or queuing its START checkpoint. Consider a pending callback followed by a completed step and an invoke whose payload serializer takes 10 ms. Step completion arms the cooldown; 3 ms now suspends before the invoke is submitted, whereas 20 ms allowed submission. If the invoked function receives the callback ID, the workflow can remain blocked until callback timeout. Register the invoke as `EXECUTING` before serialization, retain that state through startup, and then transition to `IDLE_NOT_AWAITED`. Add a composed regression test with a pending callback and delayed payload serializer.
